scope: actual standalone Cell CPU, not native egglog performance
limits: All samples and warmups retained. Ambient load and within-lane variation are material; median differences are not established causal speedups. CPU/wall includes load and export, not inference-only utilization. Profiles are separate diagnostic executions, not timing samples.

sample.limits: Sampling includes wall-time residence on parked threads; stack counts are not CPU percentages. Symbolication time is included in command end. Sampling perturbs this diagnostic; see progress_logging for whether per-Run logging is enabled.

control4.selected_limits: Inclusive frames overlap and include callees and waits; do not sum. Worker condition waits include both pool idle and inside-job waits. Context classification is heuristic. These windows are partial, sampled wall residence, not CPU percentages or isolated synchronization costs.
